mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_users ( id, name, email, phone, birth_date, status, withdrawn_at, created_at, updated_at, career, introduction, profile_image_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{status}, #{withdrawnAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{career, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{introduction, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImageId, jdbcType=OTHER} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, career = #{career, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, introduction = #{introduction, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_image_id = #{profileImageId, jdbcType=OTHER}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
